verse.verse_2: And it listens to the command of its Lord – and that befits it.
verse.verse_3: And when the earth is spread out.
verse.verse_4: And it unburdens itself of all that is in it, and becomes empty.
verse.verse_5: And it listens to the command of its Lord – and that befits it.
verse.verse_6: O man, indeed you have to surely run towards your Lord, and to meet him.
verse.verse_7: So whoever is given his record of deeds in his right hand –
verse.verse_8: Soon an easy account will be taken from him.
verse.verse_9: And he will return to his family rejoicing.
verse.verse_10: And whoever is given his record of deeds behind his back –
verse.verse_11: Soon he will pray for death.
verse.verse_12: And will go into the blazing fire.
verse.verse_13: Indeed he used to rejoice in his home.
verse.verse_14: He assumed that he does not have to return.
verse.verse_15: Surely yes, why not? Indeed his Lord is seeing him.
verse.verse_16: So by oath of the late evening’s light.
verse.verse_17: And by oath of the night and all that gathers in it.
verse.verse_18: And by oath of the moon when it is full.
verse.verse_19: You will surely go up level by level.
verse.verse_20: What is the matter with them that they do not accept faith?
verse.verse_21: And when the Qur’an is recited to them, they do not fall prostrate? (Command of Prostration # 13)
verse.verse_22: In fact the disbelievers keep denying.
verse.verse_23: And Allah well knows what they conceal in their hearts.
verse.verse_24: Therefore give them the glad tidings of a painful punishment.
verse.verse_25: Except those who believed and did good deeds – for them is a reward that will never end.
